Roman copper alloy folding knife handle, 60mm long, 22mm wide and 18mm thick with a weight of 28.92grams. The object represents a running or stretching lion. Its forepaws are outstretched, have a flat upper side and turn down at almost a right angle. It has a rectangular recess underneath to accomondate one end of the blade?
